- EB (board-level) meeting window: two 60-minute options (wk of Nov 15 or Nov 22). Client prefers earlier; they asked for availability today.
- Critical asks from Atlas: SOC2 evidence (~SLA/security packet), procurement timeline, and a short product demo for 20 minutes.

Please review the MAP tabs: Milestones, Owners, and EB Agenda. Specific asks:
- Marissa: confirm who will handle the 20-minute demo and who will present the cost/terms walk-through.
- Karthik: confirm SOC2/infosec point and whether we can deliver the summary by Nov 10.
- Ben: please update the milestone dates for final contract/signature based on reserved capacity lead times.
